vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are different colours and the colours relate to the number of mushroom you'll get. You have to figure out which colours give the most. After some time the amounts for the colours change so you have to try to guess again. Some give 0 and some give up to about 45- these amounts may be different in your game. Just do your best to get as high score as possible by collecting as may mushrooms as you can- try to remember which colours give the most and notice when it changes. Good luck! Have fun
